"""Probe (scratch, not a test): what today's launcher says for two fixture assumptions of round 3."""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-60a")
import w2_60a_support as s  # noqa: E402

base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w260a-probe-"))
try:
    # 1. an engineer launch with no research allowlist under template/ (role files still there)
    box = s.make_sandbox(base / "one")
    project = s.make_project(box, commit=False)
    (project / s.ALLOWLIST_REL).unlink()
    s.git(project, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    s.git(project, "add", "-A")
    s.git(project, "commit", "-q", "-m", "probe")
    cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(box)
    result = s.launch(box, cli, s.ENGINEER, s.T)
    print("no allowlist: exit", result.run.returncode, "starts", len(result.calls), s.said(result).strip()[:300])

    # 2. the words of the tree's own local-file refusals, for each key
    keys = {
        "agent": lambda d: d.update({"agent": s.ENGINEER}),
        "autoCompactWindow": lambda d: d.update({"autoCompactWindow": 300000}),
        "env": lambda d: d.setdefault("env", {}).update({"CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW": "300000"}),
    }
    for name, change in keys.items():
        box = s.make_sandbox(base / name)
        project = s.make_project(box)
        cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(box)
        s.rewrite_settings(project, change, s.LOCAL_SETTINGS_REL)
        result = s.launch(box, cli, s.ENGINEER, s.T)
        print(name, "exit", result.run.returncode, s.said(result).strip()[:300])
    box = s.make_sandbox(base / "notjson")
    project = s.make_project(box)
    cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(box)
    s.write(project / s.LOCAL_SETTINGS_REL, "{ not json\n")
    result = s.launch(box, cli, s.ENGINEER, s.T)
    print("not json", "exit", result.run.returncode, s.said(result).strip()[:300])
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(base)
